items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: That's when Herbie and Thomas and all of them were there that night. You played a little bit when they were between numbers.

ctx.x: You played a little bit of it. Some of it there I tried to play.

Yeah, that one little tune, about a minute. I think we made a copy. That's when Herbie and Thomas and all of them were there that night. You played a little bit when they were between numbers. Yeah. Yeah, that's it.

Most of them times, the music was all Scott music, Top Jungle music. Scott Jepsen music. Yeah. It was hard music. It was like climbing, had a part in the day you'd make, and trombone and all that, and trombone and trombone and trombone and trombone and trombone and trombone. All that number, I wish I could remember them numbers. That's the Charles Hall, I don't know them. They all had the music. Gulong. Gulong.
